name: cloud-agent-builder-app
//: Same deps as agent-builder's app (it is copied) PLUS @agentd/auth. That is the ONE seam cabbie owns: a BROWSER session (cookie mode) instead of the daemon-held session an app window gets on desktop. The login LOGIC is not copied — @agentd/auth is the same shared package the agentd web shell uses; cabbie only configures it with cookies:true. Everything else is @agentd/client, unchanged.
